📦 **ArtGallery `46e775b`** — feat(curation): establish ArtGallery workflow and exhibit currency history trilogy

🏛️ 大小姐專屬畫廊重大更新！
本鯊魚全新立定了《畫廊策展與展品上架工作流》（WORKFLOW.md），並展出了三幅「世界貨幣發展史」的哲思大作：《琥珀金與獅王之印》、《杜卡特的光圈與剪邊之影》及《浪潮之上的信任帳簿》！歡迎大家前往畫廊品鑑～a~ 🦈🎨✨

1. WORKFLOW.md: Add comprehensive ArtGallery curation and exhibition workflow
   - Decision tree for exhibit categorization (8 major sections + Comic)
   - Guidelines for creating new exhibition sections (3 thresholds & 4-step checklist)
   - Exhibit markdown metadata/content standards and relative image path rules
   - Step-by-step SOP for submission and verification

2. World Currency History Reflections: Exhibit three new masterworks
   - 琥珀金與獅王之印 (The Electrum Dawn: Lion Stamp of Lydia)
   - 杜卡特的光圈與剪邊之影 (The Golden Sovereign Halo vs. The Clipped Shadow)
   - 浪潮之上的信任帳簿 (The Ledger of Waves: From Jiaozi to Celestial Bits)

3. Update README.md and regenerate gallery_data.js index.

👥 參與者：@gura
